lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal s baanee jit naam vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: Blessed are those words, by which the Naam is chanted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad kinai viralai jaanee ||
lines.translation: Rare are those who know this, by Guru's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n s velaa jit har gaavat sunanaa aae te paravaanaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Blessed is that time when one sings and hears the Lord's Name. Blessed and approved is the coming of such a one. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: se netr paravaan jinee darasan pekhaa ||
lines.translation: Those eyes which behold the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan are approved and accepted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਕਰ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: se kar bhale jinee har jas lekhaa ||
lines.translation: Those hands which write the Praises of the Lord are good.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: se charan suhaave jo har maarag chale hau bal tin sa(n)g pachhaanaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Those feet which walk in the Lord's Way are beautiful. I am a sacrifice to that Congregation in which the Lord is recognized. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun saajan mere meet piaare ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g khin maahi udhaare ||
lines.translation: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kilavikh kaat hoaa man niramal mit gae aavan jaanaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Your sins will be cut out; your mind will be immaculate and pure. Your comings and goings shall cease. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dui kar joR ik binau kareejai ||
lines.translation: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa dubadaa pathar leejai ||
lines.translation: please bless me with Your Mercy, and save this sinking stone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau prabh bhae kripaalaa prabh naanak man bhaanaa jeeu ||4||22||29||
lines.translation: God has become merciful to Nanak; God is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||4||22||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee har har teree ||
lines.translation: The Word of Your Bani, Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun hovai param gat meree ||
lines.translation: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jalan bujhee seetal hoi manooaa satigur kaa darasan paae jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: The burning within me has been extinguished, and my mind has been cooled and soothed, by the Blessed Vision of the True Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh bhaiaa dukh door paraanaa ||
lines.translation: Happiness is obtained, and sorrow runs far away,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t rasan har naam vakhaanaa ||
lines.translation: when the Saints chant the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal neer bhare sar subhar birathaa koi na jaae jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The sea, the dry land, and the lakes are filled with the Water of the Lord's Name; no place is left empty. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa dhaaree tin sirajanahaare ||
lines.translation: The Creator has showered His Kindness;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sagale pratipaare ||
lines.translation: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: miharavaan kirapaal daiaalaa sagale tripat aghaae jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: He is Merciful, Kind and Compassionate. All are satisfied and fulfilled through Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: van trin tribhavan keeton hariaa ||
lines.translation: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds are rendered green.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanahaar khin bheetar kariaa ||
lines.translation: The Doer of all did this in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naanak tisai araadhe man kee aas pujaae jeeu ||4||23||30||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, Nanak meditates on the One who fulfills the desires of the mind. ||4||23||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meraa pitaa too(n)hai meraa maataa ||
lines.translation: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meraa ba(n)dhap too(n) meraa bhraataa ||
lines.translation: You are my Relative, and You are my Brother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meraa raakhaa sabhanee thaaee taa bhau kehaa kaaRaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: You are my Protector everywhere; why should I feel any fear or anxiety? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree kripaa te tudh pachhaanaa ||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, I recognize You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meree ot too(n)hai meraa maanaa ||
lines.translation: You are my Shelter, and You are my Honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin doojaa avar na koee sabh teraa khel akhaaRaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Without You, there is no other; the entire Universe is the Arena of Your Play. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh tudh upaae ||
lines.translation: You have created all beings and creatures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit jit bhaanaa tit tit laae ||
lines.translation: As it pleases You, You assign tasks to one and all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh keetaa teraa hovai naahee kichh asaaRaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: All things are Your Doing; we can do nothing ourselves. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaai mahaa sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, I have found great peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaai meraa man seetalaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my mind is cooled and soothed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ਬਿਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai vajee vaadhaaee naanak jitaa bikhaaRaa jeeu ||4||24||31||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, congratulations are pouring in-Nanak is victorious on the arduous battlefield of life! ||4||24||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee praan prabh manahi adhaaraa ||
lines.translation: God is the Breath of Life of my soul, the Support of my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat jeevahi gun gaai apaaraa ||
lines.translation: His devotees live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan a(n)mrit har naamaa har dhiaai dhiaai sukh paaiaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Meditating, meditating on the Lord's Name, I have found peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa dhaar jo ghar te aavai ||
lines.translation: One whose heart's desires lead him from his own home,
